title: rxvy's amethyst tools
description: Amethyst Tools is an admin utility plugin that provides special, uncraftable tools for mining 3x3 areas and felling entire trees instantly. It ensures server stability and safety by using NBT-based item identification, configurable break limits
body:
💎 Amethyst Tools: Admin Utility Suite
Supercharge your server management with powerful, lag-safe utility tools.

Amethyst Tools is a lightweight, optimized plugin designed specifically for server administrators and operators. It provides a set of "Super Tools" that allow for instant tree felling and massive excavation without the risk of crashing your server. Unlike other plugins that rely on simple item names (which players can forge), Amethyst Tools uses Persistent Data Containers (NBT) to ensure that only the specific items issued by admins possess special abilities.

Whether you are clearing land for a new spawn, removing a massive forest, or strip-mining for resources, Amethyst Tools gets the job done instantly while keeping your server running smoothly at 20 TPS.

✨ Key Features
🪓 The Amethyst Axe (Tree Capitator)
Stop breaking trees one block at a time. The Amethyst Axe detects and destroys entire trees instantly.

Smart Detection: Automatically finds connected Logs, Wood, Stems, and Hyphae.

Lag Protection: Uses a queue-based search system (instead of dangerous recursion) with a hard block limit to prevent the server from freezing when cutting down massive jungle trees.

Clean Drops: All blocks are broken naturally, dropping items as if mined by hand.

⛏️ The Amethyst Pickaxe (3x3 Mining)
Clear areas in seconds. The Amethyst Pickaxe mines a 3x3 area with every swing.

Tunneling Machine: Perfect for strip mining or hollowing out underground areas for builds.

Bedrock Safe: Automatically ignores Bedrock and Air to prevent void holes or wasted durability.

🛡️ Built-In Safety & Protection
Spawn Protection: Includes a configurable protection radius around your world spawn. Even with these powerful tools, blocks inside the safe zone cannot be broken.

NBT Security: Players cannot craft these items or create them by renaming a Netherite tool in an anvil. They must be spawned in using the admin command.

Version Support: Native support for Minecraft 1.21.1, utilizing modern block data and particle effects.

📜 Commands & Permissions
Command: /amethystgive <pickaxe|axe>

Description: Gives the specified tool to your inventory.

Permission: amethyst.admin (Default: OP)

⚙️ Configuration
Everything is fully customizable in the config.yml.

💬 Support & Community
Need help configuring the plugin? Have a suggestion for a new tool? Join our Discord community for fast support and updates!
